newsitem.title: CANADA: National Bank Q2 loan loss provisions rise.
newsitem.headline: National Bank Q2 loan loss provisions rise.

text.p: National Bank of Canada said on Thursday that its second quarter provision for loan losses rose to C$56.3 million from C$43.8 million a year earlier.
The bank said its estimated loan losses for the full year in 1997 were C$225 million, compared to C$235 million in 1996.

"The charge for loan impairment amounted to C$56.3 million for the second quarter of 1997, or one quarter of the estimated losses of C$225 million for the year. In fiscal year 1996, the charge was C$235 million, of which C$43.8 million was recorded in the second quarter," National said in a released statement.
